i.norm: Verifies that removeAccents() strips diacritics from a broad mix of accented characters — grave, acute, circumflex, umlaut, and cedilla — while preserving the original letter case and all non-accented characters (the commas separating each pair). Mapping (input → expected): uppercase grave/acute/circumflex/umlaut: È→E, É→E, Ê→E, Ë→E, Û→U, Ù→U, Ï→I, Î→I, À→A, Â→A, Ô→O lowercase grave/acute/circumflex/umlaut: è→e, é→e, ê→e, ë→e, û→u, ù→u, ï→i, î→i, à→a, â→a, ô→o cedilla: ç→c
